notes: The new relation uses accepted pseudo labels, never U truth; same-day cross-RX positives and same-RX negatives.

Weight .05 and beta .5 fixed for this research prior to the new target predictions; no target-based selection or rerun.
Main split and historical test results were previously exposed; outcomes are development evidence, not fresh independent blind confirmation.
Original paper-completion Main split Tri-SIG-TIME and ordinary PL DURA rows are matched controls; PL has different time order and recipe.

DURA-LU primary; raw and DURA-L secondary; cross_rx plus cross_both main, cross_date diagnostic.
